{{Quote|If I had not shapeshifted into a fire-resistant Gregonian salamander, I would have been killed.|Mammon Hoole, to Zak Arranda|<ref name="Hunger" />}}
The '''Gregonian salamander''' was a type of [[Fire/Legends|fire]]-resistant [[Salamander/Legends|salamander]] from<ref name="Hunger" /> the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region's]]<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref> [[Gregonia system/Legends|Gregonia system]].<ref name="Hunger" /><ref name="Planetnamia" /> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="Date">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[Galaxy of Fear: The Hunger]]'' to [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]].</ref> the [[Shi'ido]] [[Geneticist/Legends|geneticist]] [[Mammon Hoole]] attempted to trap the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]] in the [[Engine/Legends|engine]] room of his [[Starship/Legends|starship]], the [[Shroud (starship)|''Shroud'']]. However, Fett fired a [[Wrist rocket/Legends|wrist rocket]] from his [[Mandalorian armor/Legends|suit's]] [[wrist rocket launcher]] at the ship's [[Ion engine/Legends|ion drive]], which caused an explosion. In response to the flames, Hoole [[Changeling/Legends|shape-shifted]] into a Gregonian salamander. Afterward, Hoole told his adoptive [[Gender/Legends|son]], [[Zak Arranda]], that had he not morphed into a Gregonian salamander, the flames would have [[Death/Legends|killed]] him.<ref name="Hunger" />

==Behind the scenes==
Gregorian salamanders were mentioned in the [[1998]] novel ''[[Galaxy of Fear: The Hunger]]'', written by [[John Whitman]] as the twelfth and final installment of the ''[[Star Wars: Galaxy of Fear]]'' series.<ref name="Hunger" />
